name: Knowledge Work Plugins
short: Anthropic's 11 open-source plugins that set Claude up for a job, such as sales, legal, finance, data or support.
what: Each plugin bundles skills, slash commands, sub-agents and connectors for one job function. There are plugins for productivity, sales, customer support, product management, marketing, legal, finance, data, enterprise search and bio research, plus one for building your own. They are all markdown and JSON files, with no code or build steps.
who: People who use Claude Cowork or Claude Code for everyday work and want it to follow their team's way of doing things. They are built for Claude, so skip them if you use another assistant.
needs: Accounts in the tools you want a plugin to connect to, such as Slack, Notion, HubSpot or Jira

steps.text: Edit `.mcp.json` to point at your own tools, and add your terminology and processes to the skill files.

watch: Connectors link Claude to your company tools through MCP servers. Check each plugin's `.mcp.json` so you know what it will reach before you sign in.
Skills switch on by themselves when they seem relevant, so a plugin can change how Claude answers even when you don't call a command.
The README calls these generic starting points. Expect to edit them before they fit your team.
